recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Dependency. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: New Caledonia. Parliamentary democracy (territorial congress); an overseas collectivity of france.
rulers: President Emmanuel MACRON (since 14 May 2017); represented by High Commissioner Jacques BILLANT (since 3 May 2025); President of the Government Alcide PONGA (since 8 January 2025)
government: parliamentary democracy (Territorial Congress); an overseas collectivity of France
economy: upper-middle-income French Pacific territorial economy; enormous nickel reserves; ongoing French independence negotiations; large Chinese nickel exporter; luxury eco-tourism destination; large French aid recipient; high cost-of-living; lingering wealth disparities GDP (PPP): $8.469 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2015 dollars
military: no regular military forces; Territorial Directorate of the National Police of New Caledonia (DTPN), Gendarmerie of New Caledonia (2025)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
